raw.source: Recorded native IMU odometry converted to base_link with the frozen original T_B_I; continuous odom source stamps, no map corrections
raw.label: LIO estimated accumulated planar travel; not mocap ground-truth distance
raw.caveat: Unfiltered odometry integration includes pose noise. Long missing intervals are not bridged; global NDT correction jumps are excluded by choosing odom coordinates.
